خَزْقٌ inf. n. of 1. (S, * Msb, TA.) ―
-b2- [I also find in the TA, الخزق ما يثبت والخزق ماينفذ, as though meaning that خَزْقٌ signifies A thing that becomes fixed or fast: and also a thing that transpierces, or passes through: but these may be loose explanations, intended to mean that خَزْقٌ is said of that which becomes fixed or fast (as an arrow in the body pierced by it), and also of that which transpierces, or passes through: see خَسَقَ, of which the inf. n., خَسْقٌ, is said to be used in these two senses.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
